title: Reviews
description: View ratings and reviews left by customers.

help.title: About Reviews
help.overview: A review is customer feedback on a completed marketplace order: rating, optional comment, tied to the order and listing. It feeds the listing's average rating and review count.

sections.title: What you record
items: Rating is the star score the customer gives.
Order and listing identify what was reviewed; reviewer is the customer.
Create is for submitting feedback after a completed engagement.

sections.title: On this page
items: List, filter, and open reviews for moderation or support.
There is no separate publish workflow — create and edit manage the record directly.
Soft delete removes the review from default views; restore brings it back.
